Top-right: To enhance feature orthogonality, Lfgr transforms correlated representations into mutually independent vectors. Bottom-right: The low-rank adapter is decomposed into magnitude αi and direction components, with historical directions frozen to preserve early geometric alignments, while the magnitudes remain trainable for later adaptation.
